technical.zh-CN: VHB 为结构粘接胶带，Dual Lock 为可拆互锁固定件，GM641 为微结构抓握材料；对应固定、拆装和表面摩擦三个环节。
technical.en: VHB is structural bonding tape, Dual Lock removable interlocking fastening, and GM641 microstructured gripping material. They address fixation, disassembly and surface friction respectively.

original_product_line: VHB胶带、Dual Lock蘑菇搭扣、GM641抓握材料、Scotch-Weld DP460
original_application_wording: 机器人、智能设备、汽车、家电、轨交、电子及新能源的粘接、密封与保护
